rationale: Estimate-revision momentum (So 2013 ~5.8%/yr; Mill Street ~7.6%/yr decile, IC 0.23) is the strongest analyst signal on paper, but is NOT free-PIT-backtestable historically. The only free path is forward-collection of FMP /analyst-estimates snapshots, which is survivorship-contaminated BY CONSTRUCTION (free sources serve currently-listed names only; a name that delists during collection drops out). Therefore even ~6 years of accrued snapshots can never satisfy the survivorship-free bar. Only WRDS I/B/E/S or Benzinga (delisted-inclusive) could make this confirmatory.

signal.name: estimate_revision_momentum

signal.source: FMP /stable/analyst-estimates weekly snapshots (single lean source); algorithmic-aggregated proxy of true consensus -> a proxy of a proxy
signal.expected_band_anchor: half of already-decayed literature, FURTHER discounted for (a) the algorithmic-vs-true-consensus gap and (b) computed monthly-turnover cost (mcap-bucketed bps). Frozen NET so the future evaluation cannot relax it.
